{"explanation": "Prefer hybrid X25519MLKEM768 first with classical fallback, gated on OpenSSL 3.5+ where the group exists.", "patch": "diff --git a/src/include/libpq/libpq.h b/src/include/libpq/libpq.h
--- a/src/include/libpq/libpq.h
+++ b/src/include/libpq/libpq.h
@@ -136,7 +136,12 @@
 
-#ifdef USE_SSL
-#define DEFAULT_SSL_GROUPS "X25519:prime256v1"
-#else
-#define DEFAULT_SSL_GROUPS "none"
-#endif
+#ifdef USE_SSL
+#include <openssl/opensslv.h>
+#if OPENSSL_VERSION_NUMBER >= 0x30500000L
+#define DEFAULT_SSL_GROUPS "X25519MLKEM768:X25519:prime256v1"
+#else
+#define DEFAULT_SSL_GROUPS "X25519:prime256v1"
+#endif
+#else
+#define DEFAULT_SSL_GROUPS "none"
+#endif
 
", "source_refs": ["SRC1", "SRC2"]}
